## Write to me

::: {.contact-box}
The quickest route is email. Fill this in and pick how you want to send it:
nothing is stored on this site and no third party sees the message.

```{=html}
<div class="contact-form">
  <label>Subject
    <input id="cf-subject" type="text" placeholder="What is this about?">
  </label>
  <label>Message
    <textarea id="cf-body" rows="6"
      placeholder="Datasets, collaborations, questions about the code…"></textarea>
  </label>
  <div class="contact-actions">
    <button id="cf-mail" type="button">Open in my mail app</button>
    <button id="cf-gmail" type="button" class="secondary">Open in Gmail</button>
    <button id="cf-copy" type="button" class="secondary">Copy address</button>
  </div>
  <p id="cf-status" class="cf-status" role="status"></p>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const to = "n.kauan" + "@" + "gmail.com";
  const get = id => document.getElementById(id);
  const subject = () => encodeURIComponent(get("cf-subject").value || "");
  const body = () => encodeURIComponent(get("cf-body").value || "");
  const say = msg => { get("cf-status").textContent = msg; };

  get("cf-mail").addEventListener("click", () => {
    window.location.href =
      `mailto:${to}?subject=${subject()}&body=${body()}`;
    say("If nothing opened, this browser has no mail app set up. Use Gmail or copy the address.");
  });

  get("cf-gmail").addEventListener("click", () => {
    window.open(
      `https://mail.google.com/mail/?view=cm&fs=1&to=${to}&su=${subject()}&body=${body()}`,
      "_blank", "noopener");
  });

  get("cf-copy").addEventListener("click", async () => {
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(to);
      say("Address copied: " + to);
    } catch (e) {
      say("Address: " + to);
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

Or write directly to [n.kauan@gmail.com](mailto:n.kauan@gmail.com).
:::

## Where I work

Postdoctoral researcher at the LERC, Stream Ecology Lab, Department of
Ecology, Universidade do Estado do Rio de Janeiro (UERJ), Rio de Janeiro, and
associate fellow at the Instituto Nacional de Pesquisa do Pantanal (INPP).

## Collaboration

I am open to collaboration across aquatic ecology and biogeochemistry, and
happy to be approached about work that sits outside what is described on this
site. Stream metabolism, solute additions, consumer-driven nutrient recycling
and biomonitoring are where I can contribute most quickly, but a dataset
nobody has had time to analyse, a method that needs a second pair of eyes, or
an idea at the stage of a conversation are all welcome.

Suggestions about the site itself are welcome too, including where it is
unclear or wrong.
